LV_FZ_DESC: Your live Forza HUD (speed, gear, RPM and more) runs through the L!VE desktop app. Set it up once and it shows while you race.
LV_FZ_STEP1: Open the L!VE desktop app (General tab) and link this browser.
LV_FZ_STEP2: In Forza, turn on Data Out (telemetry) with the exact settings below.
LV_FZ_STEP3: Start a race. Your HUD goes live on the link at the bottom.
LV_FZ_DATAOUT_PATH: Settings → HUD and Gameplay → Data Out
LV_FZ_DATAOUT_NOTE: 127.0.0.1 because the game and the app run on the same PC. 5300 is the port the app listens on.
LV_FZ_OBS: The same link works as an OBS browser source, so you can put the HUD on your stream. It only shows while you're in a race.
LV_DESKTOP_APP_NOTE: Games and their Discord Rich Presence come from this desktop app. Anime is separate: the L!VE browser extension puts what you’re watching on your profile.
